en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of an ornate chapel interior. The ceiling is decorated with elaborate stucco reliefs and angelic figures. On the wall, there is a prominent triptych religious painting depicting biblical figures, likely related to the Passion of Christ. The text on the postcard identifies the location as the 'Dom zu Meissen' and the 'Georg-Kapelle.' The overall appearance is historical and artistic, suggestive of a significant religious site.
